verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly ships its own CLI (ldcli) for macOS, Windows and Linux that manages flags, projects, environments and other resources from the command line. Scoped API access tokens support programmatic integrations, and the integrations page describes connecting CI/CD pipelines to control release behavior. Together these cover headless operation, but CI use is only described in marketing terms. Missing for 10: explicit docs on non-interactive or token-based CLI auth in CI runners, concrete CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions usage), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
